The sorting and output construction are clean and readable. Minor weaknesses include the absence of any legacy audit stage comments (the spec allows them and the staged structure invites them), and the type annotation on `buckets` is slightly noisy. The `setdefault` pattern is idiomatic but slightly clever compared to an explicit if-not-in branch that would make the audit trail even more visible. Overall this is a strong, locally auditable realization of the oracle.

- Use explicit branch labels in local variable names when a decision affects money.
